items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the prose piece 'Indigo', and answer.

"When the order to leave the district arrived, the visitor read it twice, folded it neatly and wrote his reply that evening: he would not go. He did not shout or call for a march. He simply said he would stay and accept whatever penalty the law laid down. By morning, the courthouse square was full of farmers who had walked through the night to see a man who was not afraid."
